decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ introduction already fully represents Chainlink VRF, fully on-chain selection, provable fairness, and Basescan verification.
The winner-selection technology does not change the manual claim mode, Winners page announcement, or one-click claim interaction.
The selection method does not change which sale types fund the prize pools or the duration of that funding.
Chainlink VRF governs the separate winner-selection Requirement and does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw condition.
Chainlink VRF governs the separate winner-selection Requirement and does not change the Small Block prize amount, eligible ticket population, or draw trigger.
The prize winner-selection implementation does not alter mint price or allocation of primary-mint revenue.
The source decision does not change the required flat secondary-sale royalty or its amount.
Prize winner selection is independent of referral badge conditions and milestone thresholds.
The winner-selection technology does not change the asset delivered by a mint.
The Chainlink VRF decision does not change use of the NFT mint number as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
The prize randomness provider is unrelated to the Transak fiat on-ramp provider, payment methods, and wallet requirements.
The winner-selection technology does not alter ticket counters, eligibility windows, weighting, or post-draw reset rules.
